summaryBullets: Zuni Cafe is leaving dining demand on the table because no clear direct ordering path.
The biggest gains likely come from making reservations, ordering, and private dining paths more obvious.
Higher-margin group bookings are likely under-promoted because private dining and catering are hard to find.

leaks.title: No clear direct ordering path
leaks.whyItMatters: Takeout and catering demand leaks to marketplaces when direct ordering is absent or inconsistent.
leaks.fix: Add a direct order CTA and make it consistent across hero, menu, and footer.
leaks.evidence: No strong online ordering or pickup CTA was detected.
